add.asset.association.title: Add asset association
add.asset.association.description: Associates an existing asset ('FORM', 'OBJECT_LIST', or 'EXTERNAL_WEB_URL') with a specified HubSpot marketing campaign.

assetId.description: The unique identifier of the asset to be associated with the campaign. This ID is specific to the assetType. For FORMs, use the form's numeric ID. For OBJECT_LIST, use the list ID (ILS ID). For EMAIL, use the email's content ID. For LANDING_PAGE or BLOG_POST, use the page/post ID. These IDs can be obtained from HubSpot's UI (in the asset's URL or details panel) or by using the corresponding list/search actions for that asset type.

assetType.description: Type of asset to associate with the campaign. Commonly supported types include: 'FORM', 'OBJECT_LIST' (Static/Contact List), 'EXTERNAL_WEB_URL', 'EMAIL', 'LANDING_PAGE', 'BLOG_POST', 'CTA', 'WORKFLOW', 'SOCIAL_POST', 'WEBSITE_PAGE', 'SEQUENCE', 'MEETING_EVENT', 'PLAYBOOK', 'FEEDBACK_SURVEY', 'SALES_DOCUMENT'. HubSpot continues to expand asset type support over time.

campaignGuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the HubSpot campaign to which the asset will be associated.

add.token.to.event.template.title: Add token to event template
add.token.to.event.template.description: Adds a new custom data token to an existing event template for a specified HubSpot application, optionally populating a CRM object property if objectPropertyName is provided.

name.description: The internal name of the token, used for referencing it within templates. Must be unique for this event template. Allowed characters: alphanumeric, periods (.), dashes (-), or underscores (_).

type.description: The data type of the token. Determines how the token's value is stored and validated.

appId.description: Numeric identifier of the target application associated with the event template. Provided in the URL path.

label.description: The user-facing label for the token. This label is used for list segmentation and in reporting.

options.description: A list of options for the token, required and applicable only if the token `type` is 'enumeration'. Each option must have a 'label' and a 'value'.

eventTemplateId.description: Unique identifier of the event template. Provided in the URL path.

objectPropertyName.description: The name of an existing CRM object property (e.g., 'dealstage', 'lifecyclestage'). If provided, this token will populate the specified CRM object property associated with the event. This allows for building or updating CRM objects through the Timeline API.

associations.batch.read.title: Retrieve associations
associations.batch.read.description: Retrieve associations Batch read associations for objects to specific object type. The 'after' field in a returned paging object can be added alongside the 'id' to retrieve the next page of associations from that objectId. The 'link' field is deprecated and should be ignored. Note: The 'paging' field will only be present if there are more pages and absent otherwise.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object from which associations are being read.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object to which associations are being read.

inputs.description: An array of PublicFetchAssociationsBatchRequest objects, each specifying the details for fetching associations for a particular object. This property is required.

associations.labels.create.title: Create association label
associations.labels.create.description: Create association label Create a new label that describes the relationship between two specified CRM object types. This can help in categorizing and managing associations more effectively.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object in the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object in the association.

inverseLabel.description: An optional descriptor that clarifies the reverse relationship in the association.

label.description: A descriptor that provides context about the relationship between two associated CRM objects.

name.description: The unique identifier for the association definition.

associations.labels.list.title: Retrieve association labels
associations.labels.list.description: Retrieve association labels Retrieve all labels that describe the relationships between two specified CRM object types. These labels provide context about the nature of the associations.

fromObjectType.description: The type of the source object for the association.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object for the association.

create.a.new.marketing.email.title: Create a new marketing email
create.a.new.marketing.email.description: Creates a new marketing email in HubSpot, allowing comprehensive configuration of content, recipients, sender details, A/B testing, scheduling, web version, and other settings; the internal `name` for the email is required.

name.description: Internal name of the email, as displayed on the HubSpot email dashboard.

state.description: Current state of the email (e.g., DRAFT, SCHEDULED, PUBLISHED).

subject.description: The subject line of the marketing email.

archived.description: True if the email is archived (typically hidden from main dashboard view).

campaign.description: ID (GUID) of the associated HubSpot campaign for tracking/reporting.

language.description: Primary language of the email content.

publishDate.description: Scheduled ISO 8601 date-time for email publication or sending.

subcategory.description: Email subcategory for internal organization or specific types (e.g., 'newsletter').

activeDomain.description: Domain for sending the email; must be a connected and verified HubSpot sending domain.

rssData__url.description: URL of the RSS feed for email content. Must be valid and accessible if using RSS features.

from__replyTo.description: Primary 'From' and reply-to email address, unless `from__customReplyTo` is used.

sendOnPublish.description: True to send email immediately on publish; false to publish without sending until triggered/scheduled.

businessUnitId.description: The ID of the business unit this email is associated with, if applicable.

from__fromName.description: Sender name appearing in the 'From' field of the received email.

rssData__timing.description: A dictionary specifying the timing and scheduling details for sending RSS emails. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"dayOfWeek": {"value": "Tuesday"}, "time": {"hour": 9, "minute": 0}}.

testing__testId.description: The unique identifier for the A/B test associated with this email.

content__widgets.description: Dictionary of widgets (e.g., text, images, CTAs) and their configurations for email content. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"widgetId": {"type": "text", "content": "Hello", "style": {...}}}.

feedbackSurveyId.description: The ID of the feedback survey linked to the email.

webversion__slug.description: Custom URL slug for the email's web version (e.g., 'july-newsletter').

testing__abStatus.description: Current A/B test status for this email (e.g., master, variant).

webversion__title.description: Browser tab title for the email's web version.

content__flexAreas.description: Dictionary defining content and layout of flexible, customizable areas in the email template. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"areaName": {"content": {...}, "layout": {...}}}.

webversion__domain.description: Domain for the email's web version; defaults to HubSpot domain if unspecified.

from__customReplyTo.description: Custom reply-to email address, overrides main 'Reply To' if set.

rssData__blogLayout.description: Specifies the layout to be used for the blog RSS email.

rssData__maxEntries.description: The maximum number of blog posts (RSS entries) to include in a single RSS email.

content__smartFields.description: Dictionary of smart fields for email personalization based on contact properties. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"fieldName": {"value": "defaultValue", "conditions": {...}}}.

testing__hoursToWait.description: Hours to wait for A/B test results before sending the winning version to remaining recipients.

to__suppressGraymail.description: True to not send to contacts identified by HubSpot as 'graymail' (low engagement).

content__templatePath.description: Path to the email template in HubSpot Design Manager.

webversion__expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the web version expires and becomes inaccessible.

rssData__blogEmailType.description: The type of blog email, which determines send frequency (e.g., instant, daily, weekly).

rssData__hubspotBlogId.description: The ID of the HubSpot blog to be used for the RSS email.

to__limitSendFrequency.description: True to apply HubSpot's send frequency limits, preventing over-mailing.

to__contactIds__exclude.description: List of specific contact IDs to explicitly exclude, even if in included lists.

to__contactIds__include.description: List of specific contact IDs to include as recipients.

testing__abSuccessMetric.description: Metric (e.g., CLICKS_BY_OPENS) to determine the A/B test winning version.

content__plainTextVersion.description: Plain text version of the email, for non-HTML clients or recipient preference.

content__widgetContainers.description: Dictionary of widget containers for grouping and managing widgets in the email template. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"containerId": {"widgets": [...], "layout": {...}}}.

rssData__rssEntryTemplate.description: The HTML template for formatting each individual RSS entry within the email.

testing__abTestPercentage.description: Percentage of recipients in the A/B test group (e.g., 20 for 20%).

to__contactLists__exclude.description: List of contact list IDs whose members to explicitly exclude. HubSpot contact list IDs are typically numeric strings (e.g., '12345', '67890'). Provide the numeric ID as a string.

to__contactLists__include.description: List of contact list IDs whose members to include as recipients. HubSpot contact list IDs are typically numeric strings (e.g., '12345', '67890'). Provide the numeric ID as a string.

webversion__redirectToUrl.description: Custom URL for redirect if web version link is expired/deactivated.

rssData__blogImageMaxWidth.description: The maximum width for images included from the blog feed in the RSS email.

testing__abSamplingDefault.description: Default email version (master/variant) if A/B test is inconclusive after the test period.

webversion__metaDescription.description: Meta description for the web version, used by search engines.

content__themeSettingsValues.description: Dictionary of theme settings values to customize email appearance. Each key must map to a dictionary/object value, not a simple string. Example: {"brandColor": {"value": "#0055CC"}, "fontFamily": {"name": "Arial"}}.

testing__abSampleSizeDefault.description: Default email version (master/variant) if A/B test sample size is too small for significance.

webversion__redirectToPageId.description: ID of a HubSpot page for redirect if web version link is expired/deactivated.

rssData__useHeadlineAsSubject.description: If true, the email subject will be automatically populated from the blog post headline for RSS emails.

subscriptionDetails__subscriptionId.description: ID of the specific subscription type (e.g., newsletter, product updates).

subscriptionDetails__officeLocationId.description: ID of the office location for CAN-SPAM compliance and personalization.

subscriptionDetails__preferencesGroupId.description: ID of the subscription preferences group for managing recipient preferences.

create.ab.test.variation.title: Create A/B test variation
create.ab.test.variation.description: Creates a new A/B test variation for an existing HubSpot marketing email, using its `contentId`; the new variation is created as a draft that can be edited before publishing. This action only creates the variation—it does not start the A/B test or send emails. Note: If an active variation already exists for the email, a new one will not be created. Requires Marketing Hub Professional or Enterprise subscription.

contentId.description: The ID of the original email content to use as a template for the new variation.

variationName.description: A unique name for the new A/B test variation.

properties.description: Campaign properties including name and optional metadata.

create.campaigns.title: Create campaigns
create.campaigns.description: Creates multiple HubSpot campaigns by calling the single campaign creation endpoint for each campaign. Note: HubSpot does not provide a native batch create endpoint for campaigns. This action creates multiple campaigns by making individual API calls for each campaign in the batch.

inputs.description: List of campaign objects to create.

create.contact.from.nl.title: Create Contact From Natural Language
create.contact.from.nl.description: Creates a new contact in HubSpot from a natural language description. Fetches the contact property schema at runtime, uses an LLM to generate the correct property payload, and creates the contact. Stores the query on a standard CRM property. This connector does not extract fields from natural language.

nl_query.description: Natural language description of the contact to create. Example: 'Add Jane Smith, email jane@test.com, phone +1-555-0100, company Acme Corp'.

associations.description: Optional associations to create between the new contact and other CRM objects (e.g., companies, deals). Pass-through field, not LLM-generated.

create.crm.object.from.nl.title: Create CRM Object From Natural Language
create.crm.object.from.nl.description: Creates a new CRM object (contact, deal, company, ticket, or custom object) in HubSpot from a natural language description. Fetches the object's property schema at runtime, uses an LLM to generate the correct property payload, and creates the object. Stores the query on a standard CRM property. This connector does not extract fields from natural language.

nl_query.description: Natural language description of the record to create. Example: 'Create a contact named John Doe with email john@example.com and phone +1-555-0100'.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object to create. Standard types: 'contacts', 'deals', 'companies', 'tickets'. Can also be a custom object type ID.

associations.description: Optional associations to create between the new object and other CRM objects. Pass-through field, not LLM-generated. Each association should include 'to' and 'types'.

properties.description: {{nl_query}}

create.deal.from.nl.title: Create Deal From Natural Language
create.deal.from.nl.description: Creates a new deal in HubSpot from a natural language description. Fetches the deal property schema and pipeline stages at runtime, uses an LLM to generate the correct property payload, and creates the deal. Stores the query on a standard CRM property. This connector does not extract fields from natural language.

nl_query.description: Natural language description of the deal to create. Example: 'New deal: Enterprise License for Acme Corp, amount $50,000, closing next month'.

pipeline.description: Optional pipeline ID override. If not specified, the LLM will infer from the NL query or default to 'default'.

associations.description: Optional associations to create between the new deal and other CRM objects (e.g., contacts, companies). Pass-through field, not LLM-generated.

create.engagement.title: Create engagement
create.engagement.description: Create a legacy EMAIL, CALL, MEETING, TASK, or NOTE engagement with optional CRM associations, attachments, and type-specific metadata.

active.description: Optional active state for the engagement.

deal_ids.description: Deal IDs as digit strings to associate with the engagement.

metadata.description: Type-specific metadata using HubSpot's exact keys for the selected EMAIL, CALL, MEETING, TASK, or NOTE engagement type. For NOTE, body is the note text and is limited to 65,536 characters.

owner_id.description: HubSpot owner ID as a digit string.

ticket_ids.description: Ticket IDs as digit strings to associate with the engagement.

company_ids.description: Company IDs as digit strings to associate with the engagement.

contact_ids.description: Contact IDs as digit strings to associate with the engagement.

timestamp_ms.description: Engagement occurrence time as Unix milliseconds.

attachment_ids.description: HubSpot file IDs as digit strings; each is sent as an object with an integer id field.

engagement_type.description: Legacy engagement kind; metadata requirements vary by this value.

association_owner_ids.description: Owner IDs as digit strings to include in the associations object.

create.event.template.for.app.title: Create event template for app
create.event.template.for.app.description: Creates a new event template for a HubSpot app, defining structure, custom properties (tokens), and appearance (Markdown with Handlebars) of custom timeline events for CRM objects; this template must exist before logging corresponding events.

name.description: The name of the event template, unique for the app and object type.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the target HubSpot app.

tokens.description: Defines custom properties (tokens) for the event, which can populate CRM object properties if a token's `objectPropertyName` is set.

objectType.description: The CRM object type this event template is associated with (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies').

detailTemplate.description: Optional Markdown string with Handlebars templating for rendering HTML for expanded event details on the CRM timeline, using tokens for event-specific data.

headerTemplate.description: Optional Markdown string with Handlebars templating for rendering HTML for the event header on the CRM timeline, using tokens for event-specific data.

archived.description: Indicates if the marketing email is archived.

activeDomain.description: Connected and verified sending domain in HubSpot.

rssData__url.description: External RSS feed URL. Required for external blog RSS emails.

from__replyTo.description: 'From' email address; receives replies if `customReplyTo` is not set.

sendOnPublish.description: If true, sends email immediately on publishing, overriding `publishDate`.

businessUnitId.description: Associated business unit ID, for accounts with multiple units.

rssData__timing.description: Send timing for RSS emails. Applies if `rssData` is configured.

rssData__maxEntries.description: Maximum blog posts per RSS email. Applies if `rssData` is configured.

content__smartFields.description: Smart fields and values for email personalization.

testing__hoursToWait.description: Hours to wait for A/B test results before sending the winning version.

create.workflow.title: Create workflow
create.workflow.description: Creates a new HubSpot workflow to automate processes; ensure `enrollmentCriteria` and `actions` use properties relevant to the specified `objectTypeId`.

name.description: The unique name for the workflow.

type.description: 'CONTACT_FLOW' for contact-based workflows, 'PLATFORM_FLOW' for workflows based on other CRM object types (deals, companies, tickets, custom objects).

actions.description: Array of workflow action configurations. Each action must include: 'actionId' (unique string ID), 'type' (e.g., 'SINGLE_CONNECTION'), 'actionTypeId' (e.g., '0-1' for delay, '0-4' for email), 'actionTypeVersion' (typically 0), 'connection' (object with 'edgeType' and 'nextActionId'), and 'fields' (action-specific settings). Example: [{'actionId': '1', 'type': 'SINGLE_CONNECTION', 'actionTypeId': '0-1', 'actionTypeVersion': 0, 'connection': {'edgeType': 'STANDARD', 'nextActionId': '2'}, 'fields': {'delayMillis': 3600000}}]

flowType.description: Flow category: 'WORKFLOW' for standard workflows, 'ACTION_SET' for reusable action sets that can be called from other workflows.

isEnabled.description: Set to true to activate the workflow immediately upon creation, or false to create it in disabled state for review.

dataSources.description: Data source configurations for conditions or personalization.

description.description: Optional explanation of the workflow's purpose and functionality.

timeWindows.description: Configurations for periods when workflow actions can execute.

blockedDates.description: Configurations for dates when workflow actions should not execute.

objectTypeId.description: HubSpot internal ID for the CRM object type: '0-1' for Contacts, '0-2' for Companies, '0-3' for Deals, '0-5' for Tickets, or custom object type ID.

startActionId.description: The unique ID of the first action in the workflow. This must match the actionId of one of the actions in the actions array.

customProperties.description: Custom key-value pairs for organization or tracking.

enrollmentCriteria.description: Required configuration defining enrollment triggers for the workflow. Must include: 'type' (either 'EVENT_BASED' or 'LIST_BASED'), 'shouldReEnroll' (boolean for allowing re-enrollment), and either 'eventFilterBranches' (for event-based) or 'listFilterBranch' (for list-based enrollment). Example for event-based: {'type': 'EVENT_BASED', 'shouldReEnroll': false, 'eventFilterBranches': [{'filterBranchType': 'OR', 'filterBranchOperator': 'OR', 'filters': [{'filterType': 'PROPERTY', 'property': 'email', 'operator': 'HAS_PROPERTY'}]}]}

suppressionListIds.description: HubSpot list IDs for contacts to be prevented from enrollment.

unEnrollmentSetting.description: Defines if/how objects unenroll from other workflows upon enrolling in this one.

nextAvailableActionId.description: The next available action ID number for sequencing. This should be one higher than the highest action ID number used in the workflow.

canEnrollFromSalesforce.description: Allow contacts to be enrolled directly from Salesforce.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.associations..title: Delete an existing association for a specified object type.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.associations..description: Delete an existing association for a specified object type. Remove an association between two object types identified by the association identifier and object type. This operation is irreversible and will permanently delete the specified association.

associationIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of the association definition to delete.

objectType.description: The type of the custom object from which the association is being deleted.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.create.title: Create a new custom object schema.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.create.description: Create a new custom object schema. Create a new custom object schema by defining its properties and associations.

allowsSensitiveProperties.description: Determines if the object type can include properties that are marked as sensitive.

associatedObjects.description: Associations defined for this object type.

description.description: A brief explanation of the object type.

name.description: A unique name for this object. For internal use only.

primaryDisplayProperty.description: The name of the primary property for this object. This will be displayed as primary on the HubSpot record page for this object type.

properties.description: Properties defined for this object type.

requiredProperties.description: The names of properties that should be **required** when creating an object of this type.

searchableProperties.description: Names of properties that will be indexed for this object type in by HubSpot's product search.

secondaryDisplayProperties.description: The names of secondary properties for this object. These will be displayed as secondary on the HubSpot record page for this object type.

shouldCreateSameObjectAssociation.description: A boolean indicating whether associations should be created between objects of the same type.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.delete.title: Delete the schema of a specified custom object.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.delete.description: Delete the schema of a specified custom object. Remove a custom object schema from the account using its object type ID or fully qualified name.

objectType.description: The unique identifier of the object schema to delete.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.list.title: Retrieve all custom object schemas.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.list.description: Retrieve all custom object schemas. Retrieve all custom object schemas, with options to include property definitions, association definitions, and audit metadata.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

includeAssociationDefinitions.description: Whether to include association definitions in the response. Defaults to true.

includeAuditMetadata.description: Whether to include audit metadata in the response. Defaults to true.

includePropertyDefinitions.description: Whether to include property definitions in the response. Defaults to true.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.list.objectty.title: Retrieve the schema of a specified custom object.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.list.objectty.description: Retrieve the schema of a specified custom object. Retrieve details of a custom object schema, including its properties and associations, using the object type ID or fully qualified name.

objectType.description: The unique identifier for the CRM object type whose schema is being retrieved.

includeAssociationDefinitions.description: A boolean indicating whether to include association definitions in the response. Defaults to true.

includeAuditMetadata.description: A boolean indicating whether to include audit metadata in the response. Defaults to true.

includePropertyDefinitions.description: A boolean indicating whether to include property definitions in the response. Defaults to true.

crm-object-schemas.schemas.update.title: Update the schema of a specified custom object.
crm-object-schemas.schemas.update.description: Update the schema of a specified custom object. Update attributes of a custom object schema, such as properties and labels, using the object type ID or fully qualified name.

objectType.description: The unique identifier of the CRM object type whose schema is to be updated.

allowsSensitiveProperties.description: Determines if the object type can include properties that are marked as sensitive.

clearDescription.description: Indicates whether the description of the object type should be cleared.

description.description: A brief explanation of the object type.

primaryDisplayProperty.description: The name of the primary property for this object. This will be displayed as primary on the HubSpot record page for this object type.

requiredProperties.description: The names of properties that should be **required** when creating an object of this type.

restorable.description: Specifies if the object type can be restored after being deleted.

searchableProperties.description: Names of properties that will be indexed for this object type in by HubSpot's product search.

secondaryDisplayProperties.description: The names of secondary properties for this object. These will be displayed as secondary on the HubSpot record page for this object type.

delete.campaign.title: Delete campaign
delete.campaign.description: Permanently deletes a marketing campaign from HubSpot using its `campaignGuid`; returns a 204 No Content status even if the campaign does not exist.

campaignGuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the marketing campaign to be deleted.

delete.campaigns.batch.title: Archive a batch of campaigns
delete.campaigns.batch.description: Archives a batch of up to 50 marketing campaigns, hiding them from active views rather than permanently deleting them.

inputs.description: A list of marketing campaign identifiers to be archived in batch.

delete.marketing.email.title: Delete a marketing email
delete.marketing.email.description: Permanently deletes a marketing email from your HubSpot account. This action cannot be undone.

emailId.description: The unique identifier of the marketing email to delete.

delete.timeline.event.template.title: Delete timeline event template
delete.timeline.event.template.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specific timeline event template, identified by its `eventTemplateId`, from the application `appId`.

appId.description: The numeric identifier (positive integer) for the target application within which the event template exists. The template specified by `eventTemplateId` must be part of this application.

eventTemplateId.description: The unique identifier for the event template to be deleted. This ID must correspond to an existing template within the specified application. Typically a UUID or a system-generated string.

delete.workflow.title: Delete workflow
delete.workflow.description: Permanently deletes a HubSpot workflow by its ID; deleted workflows cannot be restored via the API and the ID must exist.

workflow_id.description: The unique identifier of the HubSpot workflow to be deleted.

enroll.contact.in.workflow.title: Enroll contact in workflow
enroll.contact.in.workflow.description: Enrolls a contact, identified by email, in a HubSpot workflow.

email.description: The email address of the contact to enroll.

workflow_id.description: The positive numeric ID of the HubSpot contact workflow, passed as a string to preserve 64-bit values.

extensions.calling.settings.create.title: Create new calling extension settings for a specific app.
extensions.calling.settings.create.description: Create new calling extension settings for a specific app. Create new settings for the calling extension associated with the specified appId.

height.description: Specifies the height of the calling extension interface.

isReady.description: Indicates if the calling extension is ready for use.

name.description: The name of the calling extension.

supportsCustomObjects.description: Indicates if the calling extension supports custom objects.

supportsInboundCalling.description: Indicates if the calling extension supports inbound calling.

url.description: The URL associated with the calling extension.

usesCallingWindow.description: Indicates if the calling extension uses a separate calling window.

usesRemote.description: Indicates if the calling extension uses remote services.

width.description: Specifies the width of the calling extension interface.

extensions.calling.settings.delete.title: Delete the calling extension settings for a specific app.
extensions.calling.settings.delete.description: Delete the calling extension settings for a specific app. Remove the calling extension settings associated with the specified appId. This action cannot be undone.

extensions.calling.settings.get.title: Retrieve the calling extension settings for a specific app.
extensions.calling.settings.get.description: Retrieve the calling extension settings for a specific app. Retrieve the current settings of the calling extension for the specified appId.

extensions.calling.settings.recording.cr.title: Create recording settings for an app.
extensions.calling.settings.recording.cr.description: Create recording settings for an app. Create new recording settings for a specific app using the provided app ID.

urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording.description: The URL used to access authenticated call recordings.

extensions.calling.settings.recording.ge.title: Retrieve recording settings for an app.
extensions.calling.settings.recording.ge.description: Retrieve recording settings for an app. Retrieve the current recording settings for a specific app using the provided app ID.

extensions.calling.settings.recording.up.title: Update recording settings for an app.
extensions.calling.settings.recording.up.description: Update recording settings for an app. Update the recording settings for a specific app using the provided app ID.

urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording.description: The URL used to access authenticated call recordings.

extensions.calling.settings.update.title: Update the calling extension settings for a specific app.
extensions.calling.settings.update.description: Update the calling extension settings for a specific app. Modify existing calling extension settings for the specified appId. Only the fields provided in the request will be updated.

height.description: The height setting for the calling extension interface.

isReady.description: Specifies whether the calling extension is ready for use.

name.description: The name of the calling extension.

supportsCustomObjects.description: Indicates if the calling extension supports custom objects.

supportsInboundCalling.description: Indicates if the calling extension supports inbound calling.

width.description: The width setting for the calling extension interface.

extensions.videoconferencing.settings.de.title: Delete settings
extensions.videoconferencing.settings.de.description: Delete settings Delete video conference extension settings for your app

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app whose video conferencing settings are to be deleted. It must be an integer.

extensions.videoconferencing.settings.ge.title: Get settings
extensions.videoconferencing.settings.ge.description: Get settings Fetch video conference extension settings for your app

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app whose video conferencing settings you want to retrieve. It should be an integer.

extensions.videoconferencing.settings.re.title: Create or update settings
extensions.videoconferencing.settings.re.description: Create or update settings Create or update video conference extension settings for your app

appId.description: The unique identifier of the app whose video conferencing settings are to be updated.

createMeetingUrl.description: A string representing the URL used to create a new meeting. This property is required.

deleteMeetingUrl.description: A string representing the URL used to delete a meeting.

fetchAccountsUri.description: A string representing the URI used to fetch account information.

updateMeetingUrl.description: A string representing the URL used to update an existing meeting.

userVerifyUrl.description: A string representing the URL used to verify a user's identity.

fetch.revenue.title: Fetch revenue
fetch.revenue.description: Fetches a revenue attribution report for a specified, existing marketing campaign, optionally using a specific attribution model and date range; if both start and end dates are given, `endDate` must not be earlier than `startDate`.

endDate.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) for filtering report data; defaults to the current date if omitted.

startDate.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for filtering report data; defaults to '2006-01-01' if omitted.

campaignGuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the marketing campaign.

attributionModel.description: Attribution model for revenue calculation; defaults to 'LINEAR' if omitted. Allowed values: 'LINEAR', 'FIRST_INTERACTION', 'LAST_INTERACTION', 'FULL_PATH', 'U_SHAPED', 'W_SHAPED', 'TIME_DECAY', 'J_SHAPED', 'INVERSE_J_SHAPED'.

get.ab.email.variation.title: Get the variation of an A/B marketing email
get.ab.email.variation.description: Retrieves the alternate variation of a specified A/B marketing email; the `emailId` must identify an email currently in an A/B test. Requires Marketing Hub Professional or Enterprise subscription.

emailId.description: The unique identifier of the A/B marketing email. If this ID refers to variation A, the details for variation B will be returned, and vice-versa.

archived.description: Boolean variable to request archived email. Set to true to retrieve archived A/B test emails.

includeStats.description: Boolean variable to request stats to be returned in response. Set to true to include email performance statistics.

workflowNames.description: Boolean variable to request name of the associated workflows in response. Set to true to include workflow names.

includedProperties.description: List of properties to be returned in the API response. If not specified, all properties will be returned.

marketingCampaignNames.description: Boolean variable to request name of the campaign in response. Set to true to include associated campaign names.

get.account.info.title: Get Account Information
get.account.info.description: Gets current HubSpot account info (email, hubId, user details) using access-token lookup.

get.aggregated.statistic.intervals.title: Get aggregated statistic intervals
get.aggregated.statistic.intervals.description: Retrieves aggregated statistics for marketing emails (e.g., send counts), grouped by specified time intervals within a defined time range.

emailIds.description: Optional list of specific email IDs to filter results; if omitted, statistics for all emails in the time range are returned.

interval.description: Time interval for aggregating email statistics, defining data granularity (e.g., YEAR, MONTH, DAY).

endTimestamp.description: End of the time span for statistics (ISO8601 timestamp); must be on or after `startTimestamp`.

startTimestamp.description: Start of the time span for statistics (ISO8601 timestamp).

get.aggregated.statistics.title: Get aggregated statistics
get.aggregated.statistics.description: Retrieves aggregated statistics for marketing emails, optionally within an ISO8601 formatted time range, by email IDs, or specific email properties.

emailIds.description: Filter statistics by specific email IDs.

property.description: Specific email property to include (e.g., 'subject', 'campaignGuid'); if omitted, all available properties are returned. See HubSpot docs for available properties.

endTimestamp.description: End of the time range (ISO8601 format); statistics are aggregated for emails sent on or before this time. Required by the API; if not provided, defaults to current time.

startTimestamp.description: Start of the time range (ISO8601 format); statistics are aggregated for emails sent on or after this time. Required by the API; if not provided, defaults to 30 days ago.

get.all.marketing.emails.for.a.hubspot.a.title: Get all marketing emails for a HubSpot account
get.all.marketing.emails.for.a.hubspot.a.description: Fetches a list of marketing emails from a HubSpot account, with options for filtering, sorting, pagination, and including performance statistics.

sort.description: A list of fields to sort the results by. Valid fields are `name`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `createdBy`, `updatedBy`. Prefix with '-' for descending order (e.g., '-createdAt'). `createdAt` is the default sort order if unspecified.

type.description: Filter emails by type. Multiple types can be specified. If omitted, emails of all types are returned. See TypeEnm for allowed values.

after.description: The cursor token to retrieve the next page of results. This value is obtained from the `paging.next.after` property of a previous paged response.

limit.description: The maximum number of emails to return per page. Default is 100, max is 100.

archived.description: Specifies whether to include archived emails in the results. Defaults to `false` (archived emails are not returned). Set to `true` to retrieve archived emails.

createdAt.description: Filter emails created at this exact ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., '2023-10-26T10:30:00Z').

updatedAt.description: Filter emails last updated at this exact ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., '2023-10-26T12:45:00Z').

isPublished.description: Filter emails based on their publication status: `true` for published emails, `false` for draft emails. If omitted, both published and draft emails are returned.

createdAfter.description: Filter emails created after this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., '2023-10-26T00:00:00Z').

includeStats.description: If `true`, includes statistics (e.g., open rates, click rates) with each email. Defaults to `false`.

updatedAfter.description: Filter emails last updated after this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., '2023-10-26T00:00:00Z').

createdBefore.description: Filter emails created before this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., '2023-10-27T00:00:00Z').

updatedBefore.description: Filter emails last updated before this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., '2023-10-27T00:00:00Z').

includedProperties.description: A list of specific property names to include in the response for each email object. If omitted, a default set of properties is returned. Consult the HubSpot API documentation for available email properties.

get.blog.post.title: Get blog post
get.blog.post.description: Retrieves one HubSpot CMS blog post by post ID.

post_id.description: Unique HubSpot ID of the blog post to retrieve.

archived.description: Whether to retrieve the archived version of the blog post.

property.description: A blog post property to include in the response.

get.campaign.title: Get campaign
get.campaign.description: Retrieves a HubSpot campaign by its ID.

campaignId.description: Unique HubSpot identifier for the campaign to retrieve.

get.campaign.metrics.title: Get campaign metrics
get.campaign.metrics.description: Retrieves key attribution metrics for an existing marketing campaign, identified by its `campaignGuid`, within an optional date range.

endDate.description: The end date (YYYY-MM-DD) for filtering report data. Defaults to the current date if not specified.

startDate.description: The start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for filtering report data. Defaults to 2006-01-01 if not specified.

campaignGuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the marketing campaign for which to retrieve metrics.

after.description: Pagination token from previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return.

get.contact.ids.title: Get contact IDs
get.contact.ids.description: Fetches a list of contact IDs for a specific HubSpot campaign based on interaction type.

after.description: A pagination cursor. Used to fetch the next set of results. Provide the 'after' value from a previous response to get subsequent pages. Example: NTI1Cg%3D%3D

limit.description: The maximum number of contact IDs to return in a single request. Default is 100.

endDate.description: The end date for filtering report data, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. If not provided, defaults to the current date.

startDate.description: The start date for filtering report data, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. If not provided, defaults to 2006-01-01.

contactType.description: The type of contact interaction to filter by. Allowed values: 'contactFirstTouch' (contacts whose first interaction was with this campaign), 'contactLastTouch' (contacts whose last interaction before a key event was with this campaign), 'influencedContacts' (all contacts who interacted with assets of this campaign).

campaignGuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the campaign for which to fetch contact IDs.

get.engagement.title: Get engagement
get.engagement.description: Retrieve one legacy aggregate engagement by its engagement ID.

engagement_id.description: The unique legacy aggregate engagement ID to retrieve.

get.event.template.title: Get specific event template for app
get.event.template.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific event template for a given application in HubSpot's CRM timeline.

appId.description: The ID of the target application for which the event template is being retrieved. This parameter is required and ensures the template lookup is specific to an app integration within HubSpot. The appId must be a valid, existing app ID in your HubSpot account.

eventTemplateId.description: The unique identifier of the event template. This ID is assigned by HubSpot when the template is created. It is required and must be a valid, existing template ID associated with the specified app.

get.marketing.email.draft.title: Get draft version of a marketing email
get.marketing.email.draft.description: Retrieves the draft version of a marketing email by its `emailId`; if no draft exists, returns the published version.

emailId.description: The unique identifier of the marketing email. Used to fetch its draft version or, if unavailable, its published version.

get.marketing.email.revision.title: Get a revision of a marketing email
get.marketing.email.revision.description: Retrieves a specific, previously saved revision of a marketing email using its unique email ID and revision ID.

emailId.description: The unique identifier of the marketing email whose revision is to be fetched.

revisionId.description: The unique identifier of the specific revision of the marketing email to be retrieved.

get.marketing.email.revisions.title: Get revisions of a marketing email
get.marketing.email.revisions.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all historical versions (including full state like content, settings, metadata) for a specified, existing marketing email; revision ID -1 identifies the current version.

after.description: Cursor for the next page of results, typically from `paging.next.after` in a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of email revisions per page. The API defaults to 100 if this parameter is not provided.

before.description: Cursor for the previous page of results, typically from `paging.prev.before` in a previous response.

emailId.description: The unique identifier of the marketing email for which revisions are to be fetched.

get.the.details.of.a.specified.marketing.title: Get the details of a specified marketing email
get.the.details.of.a.specified.marketing.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific marketing email in HubSpot using its unique email ID, optionally including performance statistics and specific properties.

emailId.description: The unique identifier of the marketing email to retrieve.

archived.description: Filter by archived status: `true` for archived, `false` for not archived. Omit to retrieve regardless of archived status.

includeStats.description: Whether to include performance statistics (e.g., open rates, click-through rates) with the email details.

includedProperties.description: Specific marketing email property names to include in the response (e.g., "name", "subject", "createdById"). If omitted, a default set of properties is returned.

get.workflow.by.id.title: Get workflow by ID
get.workflow.by.id.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for an existing HubSpot workflow by its unique ID; unsupported actions are designated 'UNSUPPORTED_ACTION' in the response.

workflow_id.description: The unique identifier of the HubSpot workflow to retrieve. This ID can be found by using the 'Get all workflows' action or from the URL when viewing a workflow in the HubSpot UI.

get.workflow.revision.title: Get workflow revision
get.workflow.revision.description: Retrieves a specific historical revision of a HubSpot workflow.

flow_id.description: Unique ID of the HubSpot workflow whose revision to retrieve.

revision_id.description: Unique ID of the historical workflow revision to retrieve.

get.workflows.title: Get all workflows
get.workflows.description: Retrieves a list of workflow summaries (ID, name, type, status) from HubSpot, using the 'limit' parameter for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of workflows to retrieve per API call, used for pagination.

imports.cancel.title: Cancel an active import
imports.cancel.description: Cancel an active import This allows a developer to cancel an active import.

importId.description: The unique identifier of the import process to cancel. It must be an integer.

imports.errors.get.title: Retrieve errors for a specific import
imports.errors.get.description: Retrieve errors for a specific import Retrieves detailed error records for a specific import operation, enabling you to identify and troubleshoot records that failed during processing.

importId.description: The unique identifier of the import for which to retrieve errors.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

includeErrorMessage.description: A boolean indicating whether to include detailed error messages in the response.

includeRowData.description: A boolean indicating whether to include the row data associated with each error in the response.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

imports.get.title: Get the information on any import
imports.get.description: Get the information on any import A complete summary of an import record, including any updates.

importId.description: The unique identifier of the import to retrieve.

imports.list.title: List Imports
imports.list.description: List Imports Retrieve a list of imports in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to view the imports that have been processed, providing details about each import. It supports pagination to navigate through large sets of import data.

after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

integrators.timeline.events.batch.create.title: Batch insert events
integrators.timeline.events.batch.create.description: Batch insert events Insert a batch of new App Event occurrences into the timeline. Each occurrence in the batch is immutable, and if an occurrence with the same ID already exists, the entire batch will be rejected. The batch can include occurrences from multiple event types, but all must belong to a single portal.

inputs.description: An array of AppEventOccurrence objects, each representing an individual app event occurrence to be included in the batch. This property is required.

integrators.timeline.events.create.title: Send event data (single)
integrators.timeline.events.create.description: Send event data (single) Send a single instance of event data to a specified event type.

domain.description: The domain associated with the event occurrence, represented as a string.

email.description: The email address associated with the event occurrence, represented as a string.

eventTypeName.description: The name of the event type, represented as a string.

extraData.description: An object containing additional data related to the event occurrence.

id.description: The unique identifier for this event occurrence, represented as a string.

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object related to the event, represented as a string.

objectTypeFullyQualifiedName.description: The fully qualified name of the object type associated with the event, represented as a string.

properties.description: A map of custom property names to their values, represented as an object with string values.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the event occurred, represented in ISO 8601 format.

utk.description: The user token key (utk) associated with the event, represented as a string.

list.assets.title: List assets
list.assets.description: Lists assets of a specific `assetType` for a given HubSpot marketing `campaignGuid`, optionally including performance metrics for a date range.

after.description: Pagination cursor from 'paging.next.after' of a previous response; results will begin after this cursor.

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return per response (positive integer).

endDate.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) for asset performance metrics. Metrics are not fetched if `startDate` or `endDate` is missing/invalid.

assetType.description: The specific type of asset to retrieve (e.g., BLOG_POST, LANDING_PAGE); only one asset type per request.

startDate.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) for asset performance metrics. Metrics are not fetched if `startDate` or `endDate` is missing/invalid.

campaignGuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of an existing marketing campaign whose assets are to be listed.

list.audit.logs.title: List audit logs
list.audit.logs.description: Lists Enterprise-only HubSpot account audit logs with optional filters and pagination.

sort.description: HubSpot sort expressions, sent as repeated `sort` query parameters.

after.description: Paging cursor from a previous response's `paging.next.after` field.

limit.description: Maximum number of audit log entries to return per page.

actingUserId.description: User IDs whose actions should be returned. Each ID is sent as a repeated `actingUserId` query parameter.

occurredAfter.description: Return actions that occurred after this RFC3339 timestamp.

occurredBefore.description: Return actions that occurred before this RFC3339 timestamp.

fillFinalTimestamp.description: Value for HubSpot's `fillFinalTimestamp` query parameter. HubSpot does not document its behavior.

list.call.dispositions.title: List call dispositions
list.call.dispositions.description: Return HubSpot call disposition IDs and labels.

list.company.activities.title: List company activities
list.company.activities.description: List all activity/engagement associations from a company to a specified activity type (calls, emails, meetings, notes, or tasks). Returns the IDs of associated engagement records. Use this action when you need to retrieve all activities of a specific type for a company to build a timeline or activity history.

after.description: Paging cursor token from a previous response to fetch the next page of results. Leave empty to start from the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of activity associations to return per page. Default is 25.

companyId.description: The unique ID of the company whose activities you want to retrieve.

activityType.description: Type of activity/engagement to retrieve (e.g., 'calls', 'emails', 'meetings', 'notes', 'tasks'). Specify the plural form of the engagement object type.

list.company.calls.title: List company calls
list.company.calls.description: Lists all calls associated with a specific HubSpot company. Returns call IDs and their association types with the company. Use this action when you need to retrieve all call activity records linked to a company without fetching full call details. For full call properties, use the returned call IDs with a call read action.

after.description: Paging cursor token from a previous response to fetch the next page of results. Leave empty to start from the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of call associations to return per page. Default is 25.

company_id.description: The unique ID of the company whose associated calls you want to retrieve.

list.company.meetings.title: List company meetings
list.company.meetings.description: List all meetings associated with a specific company in HubSpot. Returns meeting IDs and association metadata for meetings linked to the company record. Use this action when you need to retrieve all meetings scheduled with or related to a particular company.

name.description: The internal property group name, which must be used when referencing the property group via the API.

properties.groups.delete.title: Archive a property group
properties.groups.delete.description: Archive a property group Move a property group identified by {groupName} to the recycling bin.

groupName.description: The unique name of the property group to be deleted.

objectType.description: The type of object for which the property group is defined, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

properties.groups.get.title: Read a property group
properties.groups.get.description: Read a property group Read a property group identified by {groupName}.

groupName.description: The name of the property group to retrieve details for.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object for which the property group is being retrieved, such as contacts or deals.

locale.description: The language locale to use for the response. This can affect the language of the labels and descriptions returned.

properties.groups.list.title: Read all property groups
properties.groups.list.description: Read all property groups Read all existing property groups for the specified object type and HubSpot account.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object for which to retrieve property groups, such as 'contacts' or 'deals'.

locale.description: The language locale to use for property group labels. This can help in displaying labels in the preferred language.

properties.groups.update.title: Update a property group
properties.groups.update.description: Update a property group Perform a partial update of a property group identified by {groupName}. Provided fields will be overwritten.

groupName.description: The name of the property group to update.

objectType.description: The type of object for which the property group is being updated, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

displayOrder.description: Property groups are displayed in order starting with the lowest positive integer value. Values of -1 will cause the property group to be displayed after any positive values.

label.description: A human-readable label that will be shown in HubSpot.

properties.list.title: Read all properties
properties.list.description: Read all properties Read all existing properties for the specified object type and HubSpot account.

objectType.description: The type of CRM object for which properties are being retrieved, such as 'contacts', 'companies', etc.

archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

dataSensitivity.description: Filter properties based on data sensitivity level. Valid values are 'non_sensitive', 'sensitive', and 'highly_sensitive'. Defaults to 'non_sensitive'.

locale.description: Specify the locale to retrieve properties in a particular language or regional format.

properties.description: A comma-separated list of property names to include in the response.

properties.update.title: Update a property
properties.update.description: Update a property Perform a partial update of a property identified by { propertyName }. Provided fields will be overwritten.

objectType.description: The type of object for which the property is being updated, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

propertyName.description: The unique name of the property to update.

calculationFormula.description: Represents a formula that is used to compute a calculated property.

currencyPropertyName.description: A string specifying the name of the property that holds the currency information, applicable when showCurrencySymbol is true.

description.description: A description of the property that will be shown as help text in HubSpot.

displayOrder.description: Properties are displayed in order starting with the lowest positive integer value. Values of -1 will cause the Property to be displayed after any positive values.

fieldType.description: Controls how the property appears in HubSpot.

formField.description: Whether or not the property can be used in a HubSpot form.

groupName.description: The name of the property group the property belongs to.

hidden.description: If true, the property won't be visible and can't be used in HubSpot.

label.description: A human-readable property label that will be shown in HubSpot.

numberDisplayHint.description: A string providing a hint for displaying number values. Valid values include 'unformatted', 'formatted', 'currency', 'percentage', 'duration', and 'probability'.

options.description: A list of valid options for the property.

showCurrencySymbol.description: A boolean indicating whether to display a currency symbol for number fields formatted as currency.

textDisplayHint.description: A string providing a hint for displaying text values. Valid values include 'unformatted_single_line', 'multi_line', 'email', 'phone_number', 'domain_name', 'ip_address', 'physical_address', and 'postal_code'.

type.description: The data type of the property.

publish.marketing.email.title: Publish or send a marketing email
publish.marketing.email.description: Publishes or sends a specified HubSpot marketing email that is valid and ready for sending; requires Marketing Hub Enterprise or the transactional email add-on.

email_id.description: Identifier of the HubSpot marketing email to publish or send.

purge.schema.title: Purge schema by object type
purge.schema.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes the schema for an existing `objectType` in HubSpot CRM; this deprecated endpoint should be used with extreme caution.

objectType.description: The specific object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', or a custom object ID) for which the schema will be permanently deleted. Must be an exact, case-sensitive match to a valid object type defined in HubSpot.

read.budget.title: Read budget
read.budget.description: Fetches detailed budget (total, spent, remaining) and spend information for a marketing campaign, including an 'order' field for sequencing budget/spend items (0 is oldest).

campaignGuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the marketing campaign for which to retrieve budget information.

remove.asset.association.title: Remove asset association
remove.asset.association.description: Disassociates an asset from a HubSpot marketing campaign. Supports a wide range of asset types including forms, landing pages, emails, blog posts, workflows, static lists, and more.

assetId.description: The unique identifier of the asset.

assetType.description: The category/type of asset to disassociate from the campaign. Supported types include: AD_CAMPAIGN, BLOG_POST, CALL, CASE_STUDY, CTA, CTA_LEGACY, EXTERNAL_WEB_URL, FEEDBACK_SURVEY, FORM, FILE, KNOWLEDGE_BASE_ARTICLE, LANDING_PAGE, MARKETING_EMAIL, MARKETING_EVENT, MEETING_EVENT, PLAYBOOK, PODCAST_EPISODE, SALES_DOCUMENT, SALES_EMAIL, SEQUENCE, MARKETING_SMS, SOCIAL_POST, OBJECT_LIST (static lists), VIDEO, WEBSITE_PAGE, AUTOMATION_PLATFORM_FLOW (workflows), and others.

campaignGuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the HubSpot campaign.

remove.token.from.event.template.title: Remove token from event template
remove.token.from.event.template.description: Removes a token from a HubSpot event template, preventing its inclusion in new events created from that template.

appId.description: The unique identifier of the target application associated with the event template. Must be a valid integer representing the ID of your HubSpot app.

tokenName.description: The name of the token to be removed from the event template. Must be a string that exactly matches an existing token's name within the specified template (case-sensitive).

eventTemplateId.description: The unique identifier of the event template from which the token will be removed. Must be a valid string representing an existing event template ID in your HubSpot account.

render.event.detail.template.title: Render event detail template
render.event.detail.template.description: Renders detailed information for a specific HubSpot CRM timeline event using a predefined event template, ignoring `extraData` references in the template not present in event data.

eventId.description: The unique ID for a specific HubSpot CRM timeline event to render.

eventTemplateId.description: The unique ID for an existing HubSpot event template to use for rendering.

render.event.header.or.detail.as.html.title: Render event header or detail as html
render.event.header.or.detail.as.html.description: Renders an event's header or detail template as HTML for a specified event on the HubSpot CRM timeline, using a given event template ID and event ID.

detail.description: If true, renders the detailTemplate; if false or not provided, renders the headerTemplate.

eventId.description: The unique identifier for an existing event on the HubSpot timeline whose data will be used in the rendering.

eventTemplateId.description: The unique identifier for an existing event template to be used for rendering.

reset.draft.title: Reset draft
reset.draft.description: Resets a marketing email's draft to its currently published (live) version, discarding all unpublished changes; the email must have a live version to revert to.

emailId.description: Identifier of the marketing email whose draft will be reset to its currently published (live) version.

restore.email.revision.title: Restore a revision of a marketing email to draft state
restore.email.revision.description: Restores a specific revision of a marketing email to a DRAFT state, overwriting any existing draft.

emailId.description: The unique identifier of the marketing email.

revisionId.description: The specific revision ID of the marketing email to restore.

restore.marketing.email.revision.title: Restore a revision of a marketing email
restore.marketing.email.revision.description: Restores a specific, existing, non-active revision of a marketing email to become the new live version for that email.

revisionId.description: Identifier of the specific email revision to restore.

retrieve.timeline.event.by.ids.title: Retrieve timeline event by ids
retrieve.timeline.event.by.ids.description: Retrieves a specific HubSpot CRM timeline event by its application ID, event template ID, and event ID, returning event details including timestamp, tokens, and associated object information.

eventId.description: The unique identifier for the specific timeline event. This ID uniquely identifies the event within the context of its template and must correspond to an existing event in your HubSpot CRM timeline.

applicationId.description: The HubSpot application ID that created the timeline event. This is the ID of the developer app or integration that generated the timeline events you want to retrieve.

eventTemplateId.description: The unique identifier for the event template (also called event type ID). This ID is crucial for locating the specific type of event and must correspond to a pre-defined event template in your HubSpot account.

after.description: Pagination token from previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return.

query.description: Text search query to find campaigns by name.

start.import.title: Initiate data import process
start.import.description: Call this action to start an asynchronous data import into HubSpot CRM using uploaded files and a detailed `importRequest` JSON configuration, ensuring this JSON correctly maps file columns to HubSpot properties and files align with these mappings.

files.description: The binary content of the file(s) to be imported. Supported formats typically include CSV, XLSX, and XLS. Ensure the file structure aligns with the mappings defined in `importRequest`.

importRequest.description: A JSON string specifying the configuration for the import process. This configuration dictates how data from the uploaded file(s) is mapped and imported into HubSpot. Key properties include `name` (a descriptive name for the import, e.g., "Q3 Contact Import"), `dateFormat` (e.g., 'MONTH_DAY_YEAR', 'DAY_MONTH_YEAR'), `importOperations` (defines if the import should create and update, only create, or only update records, e.g., 'CREATE_AND_UPDATE'), and `files` (an array detailing each file, its format, and `columnMappings`). The `columnMappings` are crucial as they map spreadsheet columns to HubSpot CRM object properties (e.g., map 'Email Address' column to 'CONTACT' object's 'email' property).

update.a.marketing.email.title: Update a marketing email
update.a.marketing.email.description: Updates properties of an existing marketing email identified by its `emailId`; unspecified fields retain their current values.

name.description: The internal name of the email as it appears in the HubSpot dashboard.

state.description: The desired state of the email after the update. Common states include 'DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED', 'PUBLISHED'.

emailId.description: The unique ID of the marketing email to be updated.

subject.description: The subject line of the marketing email.

archived.description: Set to `true` to archive the marketing email, or `false` to make it active (unarchive).

campaign.description: The ID of the HubSpot campaign this email is associated with.

language.description: The primary language of the email, using ISO 639-1 language codes (e.g., 'en') or language-locale codes (e.g., 'en-us').

publishDate.description: The scheduled publication date and time for the email in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-12-31T10:00:00Z'). Used for scheduled emails.

subcategory.description: The subcategory of the email, often used for organization (e.g., 'newsletter', 'promotional').

activeDomain.description: The domain from which this email will be sent (e.g., 'info.example.com'). Must be a connected sending domain in HubSpot.

rssData__url.description: The URL of the external RSS feed if not using a HubSpot blog.

from__replyTo.description: The email address used as the 'From' address and default 'Reply-To' address. Must be a verified address in HubSpot.

sendOnPublish.description: If `true` and the email state is set to 'PUBLISHED', the email will be sent immediately. If `false` for a 'PUBLISHED' state, it implies it was already sent or is a template.

businessUnitId.description: The ID of the business unit this email belongs to. Requires the Business Units add-on for HubSpot.

from__fromName.description: The sender's name as it appears in the recipient's inbox (e.g., 'Marketing Team').

rssData__timing.description: A dictionary defining the scheduling for RSS emails (e.g., time of day, day of week/month). The structure depends on `blogEmailType`.

testing__testId.description: The unique identifier of the A/B test, if applicable.

content__widgets.description: A dictionary specifying the configuration and content of various widgets (modules) used in the email.

webversion__slug.description: The URL slug for the web version of the email (e.g., 'july-newsletter-2024').

webversion__title.description: The title displayed in the browser tab for the web version of the email.

content__flexAreas.description: A dictionary defining content for flexible column areas within drag-and-drop email templates.

webversion__domain.description: The domain to be used for the web version of this email. If not specified, the default portal domain is used.

from__customReplyTo.description: A custom email address for replies. If set, this overrides the main `replyTo` address for replies.

rssData__blogLayout.description: Defines the layout style for displaying blog posts within an RSS email.

rssData__maxEntries.description: The maximum number of blog posts to include in a single RSS email.

content__smartFields.description: A dictionary of smart fields and their values/configurations used in the email content. Enables personalization based on contact properties.

testing__hoursToWait.description: Time limit in hours on gathering test results. After this time is up, the winning version will be sent to the remaining contacts.

to__suppressGraymail.description: If `true`, HubSpot will attempt to avoid sending this email to contacts classified as 'graymail' (low engagement).

content__templatePath.description: The path to the email template file within the HubSpot Design Manager (e.g., 'marketplace/some_template_name').

webversion__expiresAt.description: The date and time when the web version link will expire, in ISO 8601 format. After this time, the link may redirect or show an error.

rssData__blogEmailType.description: Specifies the type of RSS email, such as instant, daily, weekly, or monthly.

rssData__hubspotBlogId.description: The ID of the HubSpot blog used as the source for an RSS-to-email.

to__limitSendFrequency.description: If `true`, respects HubSpot's send frequency limits for contacts. If `false`, may override these limits.

to__contactIds__exclude.description: A list of contact IDs to specifically exclude from receiving this email.

to__contactIds__include.description: A list of contact IDs to specifically include as recipients for this email.

testing__abSuccessMetric.description: Metric to determine the winning version that will be sent to the remaining contacts (e.g., 'CLICKS_BY_OPENS').

content__plainTextVersion.description: The plain text version of the email. If omitted, HubSpot may auto-generate it from the HTML content.

content__widgetContainers.description: A dictionary defining the layout and content of widget containers in the email template.

rssData__rssEntryTemplate.description: The HTML template used to render each individual blog post (entry) in an RSS email.

testing__abTestPercentage.description: The percentage of recipients who will be part of the A/B test group (e.g., 50 for 50%).

to__contactLists__exclude.description: A list of contact list IDs whose members should be excluded from receiving this email.

to__contactLists__include.description: A list of contact list IDs whose members should receive this email.

webversion__redirectToUrl.description: An external URL to redirect to if the web version link is expired or disabled, used if `redirectToPageId` is not set.

rssData__blogImageMaxWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels for images included from an RSS feed in the email.

testing__abSamplingDefault.description: Version of the email that should be sent if the results are inconclusive after the test period (e.g., 'master', 'variant').

webversion__metaDescription.description: The meta description for the web version of the email, used by search engines.

content__themeSettingsValues.description: A dictionary of theme settings overrides for the email template. Allows customization of global theme styles.

testing__abSampleSizeDefault.description: Version of the email that should be sent if there are too few recipients to conduct an AB test (e.g., 'master', 'variant').

webversion__redirectToPageId.description: The ID of a HubSpot-hosted page to redirect to if the web version link is expired or manually disabled.

rssData__useHeadlineAsSubject.description: If `true`, the headline of the latest blog post will be used as the email's subject line for RSS emails.

subscriptionDetails__subscriptionId.description: The ID of the specific email subscription type (e.g., marketing, newsletter) this email belongs to.

subscriptionDetails__officeLocationId.description: The ID of the CAN-SPAM office location to be used in the email footer.

subscriptionDetails__preferencesGroupId.description: The ID of the subscription preferences page/group associated with this email. Allows recipients to manage their preferences.

update.campaign.title: Update campaign
update.campaign.description: Partially updates specific, writable properties of an existing HubSpot marketing campaign identified by `campaignGuid`; an empty string value in `properties` clears a property.

properties.description: Dictionary of campaign properties to update. Keys are internal property names (e.g., hs_name, hs_campaign_status, hs_start_date), values are their new string values. Values overwrite existing ones. Attempting to update read-only or non-existent properties will result in an error. To clear a property, set it to an empty string.

campaignGuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the HubSpot marketing campaign to update.

update.campaigns.title: Update a batch of campaigns
update.campaigns.description: Updates properties for up to 50 existing HubSpot marketing campaigns in a single batch operation.

inputs.description: A list of campaign objects to update. Each object must include the campaign 'id' and a 'properties' dictionary.

update.event.template.title: Update existing event template
update.event.template.description: Updates an existing HubSpot event template's name, display templates, and tokens; providing `tokens` replaces the entire existing list, and the `id` in the request body must match `eventTemplateId` in the path.

id.description: Unique identifier of the event template; must match `eventTemplateId` in the URL path.

name.description: New name for the event template.

appId.description: ID of the application associated with the event template.

tokens.description: List of token definitions; replaces all existing tokens for the template.

detailTemplate.description: Markdown for the event's detailed timeline view, using Handlebars for dynamic data (e.g., `{{token_name}}`).

headerTemplate.description: Markdown for the event's header on the timeline, using Handlebars for dynamic data (e.g., `{{token_name}}`).

eventTemplateId.description: Unique identifier of the event template to update.

update.token.on.event.template.title: Update token on event template
update.token.on.event.template.description: Updates the label or options of an existing token within a specified HubSpot CRM event template; token name and data type remain unchanged.

appId.description: Unique identifier (ID) of the application associated with the event template and token.

label.description: New human-readable label for the token, displayed in UIs and used for segmentation/reporting.

options.description: List of option objects defining selectable choices, applicable only if the token's type is 'enumeration'. Required to modify options for an enumeration type token.

tokenName.description: Name of the token to update within the specified event template; must match an existing token's name.

eventTemplateId.description: Unique identifier (ID) of the event template containing the token to update.

objectPropertyName.description: Name of the CRM object property this token populates, linking its value to a CRM object property. If null, no direct mapping.

update.workflow.title: Update workflow
update.workflow.description: Fully replace an existing Automation v4 workflow at its current revision.

flow_id.description: ID of the existing HubSpot workflow to replace.

workflow.description: Complete ApiFlowPutRequest using exact HubSpot camelCase keys. Both workflow variants require type, actions, blockedDates, customProperties, isEnabled, revisionId, and timeWindows. A CONTACT_FLOW also requires canEnrollFromSalesforce and suppressionListIds. Copy only fields represented by this request schema from a fresh workflow read; response-only fields such as id, createdAt, updatedAt, dataSources, flowType, objectTypeId, and nextAvailableActionId are not accepted by the PUT contract.

who.am.i.title: Who Am I
who.am.i.description: Return the connected HubSpot account (portal id, domain). HubSpot identity is account-level, not per-user.
